typeName.description: The {@link Persistable} type that this spec applies to.

alertKey.description:
The key in {@link ReliabilityAlertType} that points to the muted subject for a given alert.
Example: 'triggeringModel' or 'sensor'.

title:
Specification describing how a mutable {@link ReliabilityAlertType} maps its data
between the {@link AlertMutedPeriod}, the {@link AlertMutedPeriodSpec}, and the alert itself.

Each {@link ReliabilityAlertMutableSpec} defines:
 - Which field in {@link AlertMutedPeriod} is being set.
 - Which field in {@link AlertMutedPeriodSpec} contains the list of subjects to mute.
 - Which key in {@link ReliabilityAlertType} identifies the muted subject for that alert.

This mapping is used when creating new {@link AlertMutedPeriod}s.
If the expected data is not present in the given alert or spec, an error will be thrown.
name: ReliabilityAlertMutableSpec
